# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.0 Worker 4 Slot 87: Collector's 500-Year Imperial Chronicle (oe_chr_, 18 milestones, 4 historiographical traditions, native add_timeline_note, 0 vanilla/GUI overrides). Generated by gen_collector_chronicle.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Assigns default historiographical tradition (1 Chronographia / 2 Shilu / 3 Vakanuvis / 4 Annales Regni).
oe_chr_col_assign_default_tradition = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_tradition } }
		if = { limit = { oe_chr_col_is_trad_chronographia = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_tradition value = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { oe_chr_col_is_trad_shilu = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_tradition value = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { oe_chr_col_is_trad_vakanuvis = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_tradition value = 3 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_tradition value = 4 } }
	}
}

# Country scope. Updates peak stats and 5-century archive snapshots (1437/1537/1637/1737/1800).
oe_chr_col_update_ledger = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_peak_locs }
				AND = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_peak_locs num_locations > var:oe_chr_col_peak_locs }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_peak_locs value = num_locations }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_peak_heg }
				AND = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_peak_heg oe_chr_col_live_heg_count > var:oe_chr_col_peak_heg }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_peak_heg value = oe_chr_col_live_heg_count }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_max_held }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_peak_heg }
					AND = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_peak_heg var:oe_heg2_max_held > var:oe_chr_col_peak_heg }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_peak_heg value = var:oe_heg2_max_held }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { current_year >= 1437 NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_c1_locs } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_c1_locs value = num_locations }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_c1_inc value = monthly_income_total }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { current_year >= 1537 NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_c2_locs } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_c2_locs value = num_locations }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_c2_inc value = monthly_income_total }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { current_year >= 1637 NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_c3_locs } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_c3_locs value = num_locations }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_c3_inc value = monthly_income_total }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { current_year >= 1737 NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_c4_locs } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_c4_locs value = num_locations }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_c4_inc value = monthly_income_total }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { current_year >= 1800 NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_c5_locs } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_c5_locs value = num_locations }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_c5_inc value = monthly_income_total }
	}
}

# Country scope (human-only). Annual December milestone audit, centennial retrospectives, and 1836 verdict.
oe_chr_col_sync_human_country = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	oe_chr_col_assign_default_tradition = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_init_c } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_init_c value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_verdict_done value = 0 }
	}
	oe_chr_col_update_ledger = yes
	oe_chr_col_eval_milestones = yes
	if = {
		limit = { oe_main_mod_1337_showcase_allowed = yes is_ai = no current_year >= 1437 current_year < 1835 NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_ev3_done } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_ev3_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_chr.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { oe_main_mod_1337_showcase_allowed = yes is_ai = no current_year >= 1537 current_year < 1835 NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_ev4_done } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_ev4_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_chr.4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { oe_main_mod_1337_showcase_allowed = yes is_ai = no current_year >= 1637 current_year < 1835 NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_ev5_done } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_ev5_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_chr.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { oe_main_mod_1337_showcase_allowed = yes is_ai = no current_year >= 1737 current_year < 1835 NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_ev6_done } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_ev6_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_chr.6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { oe_main_mod_1337_showcase_allowed = yes is_ai = no current_year >= 1800 current_year < 1835 NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_ev7_done } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_ev7_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_chr.7
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { oe_main_mod_1337_showcase_allowed = yes AND = { oe_byz_core_active = yes oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes oe_main_mod_old_world_event_allowed = yes } } is_ai = no NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_ev8_done } OR = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_m10 has_variable = oe_chr_col_m16 } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_ev8_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_chr.8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { oe_main_mod_1337_showcase_allowed = yes AND = { oe_byz_core_active = yes oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes oe_main_mod_old_world_event_allowed = yes } } is_ai = no current_year >= 1835 NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_ev9_done } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_ev9_done value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_verdict_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_chr.9
	}
}

# Slot 87 Mainline Entry (called from oe_mainline_lock.txt in Dec or first-init).
oe_chr_monthly = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_chr_col_init } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_init value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no NOT = { var:oe_chr_col_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now } }
		oe_chr_col_sync_human_country = yes
	}
}

# Dev Page 82: Unlock 12 Collector milestones (m01..m12), inscribe timeline notes, and open oe_chr.1.
oe_chr_dev_unlock_12 = {
	oe_chr_col_assign_default_tradition = yes
	oe_chr_col_update_ledger = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_m01 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_y01 value = current_year }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_m02 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_y02 value = current_year }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_m03 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_y03 value = current_year }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_m04 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_y04 value = current_year }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_m05 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_y05 value = current_year }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_m06 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_y06 value = current_year }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_m07 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_y07 value = current_year }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_m08 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_y08 value = current_year }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_m09 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_y09 value = current_year }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_m10 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_y10 value = current_year }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_m11 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_y11 value = current_year }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_m12 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_y12 value = current_year }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = capital }
		capital = {
			add_timeline_note = {
				key = oe_chr_col_note_m01
				location = this
				show_in_pop_graph = yes
				unique = yes
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_chr.1
}

# Dev Page 82: Immediately fire 1836 Grand Collector's Apotheosis Verdict (oe_chr.9).
oe_chr_dev_fire_1836 = {
	oe_chr_col_assign_default_tradition = yes
	oe_chr_col_update_ledger = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_verdict_done value = 1 }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_chr.9
}

oe_chr_dev_readout = {
	oe_chr_col_assign_default_tradition = yes
	oe_chr_col_update_ledger = yes
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_chr.90
}

# Read-only v11.0 cross-worker variable contract schema (never executed at runtime).
oe_chr_col_v110_contract_schema = {
	if = {
		limit = { always = no }
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis_quarantine_triumph value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_max_held value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_apex_declared value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_victor value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_bloc value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_is_elysia value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_outcome value = 1 }
	}
}
